outcome: Cesarean section for a reason related to CD
History of obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI)
finding: Perineal involvement, history of perineal surgery, and history of OASI were significantly associated with the decision to perform a cesarean section in pregnant women with Crohn's disease.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 25% of the patients with Crohn's disease due to concerns related to their condition.
